component.name: Megacubo
component.summary: Free, open-source M3U/IPTV player for live TV, radio and personal playlists

description.p: Megacubo is a free, open-source IPTV player for live TV, radio and personal M3U playlists. It plays the playlists and streams you or the community provide; it does not sell, bundle or host TV content.
The internet already carries thousands of publicly available channels, radio stations and live streams. Megacubo helps you organise and watch that open media in one place.

ul.li: M3U/M3U8 playlist player with live TV and radio
Community mode to discover public streams shared by other users
Bookmarks, watch history and a multi-language interface
Optional add-ons: scheduled recordings and Cast support

description.p: Megacubo does not decide what you watch: you are responsible for the sources and playlists you add.
